title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 4.33 (active) at 17:00 UTC on 4 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 4 日 17:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 4.33（活躍）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 4.33 (4P) at 17:00 UTC on 4 October 2026. The 17:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 17:59; hour-start 4.33/4P, hour-end 4.33/4P). Last-180 maximum is 5.33 (first at 2026-10-04T18:36:00Z; label 5P). Published-window maximum is 5.33 (first at 2026-10-04T18:36:00Z; label 5P). Window start 2026-10-04T12:57:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp reached 5.33 this window. The 18 UTC on 2026-10-04 hour is still incomplete (55 samples through 18:54).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
